crt_thread_lifecycle.scope: Real original thread-data and CRT allocation/release PPC bodies compared with the recovered composition. Covers binding success, binding failure with release, and callback changes to full r13; preserves the 112-byte caller frame and live error-state lookup.
crt_thread_lifecycle.limits: Lower heap services reuse previously validated semantic implementations. TLS/kernel and callback contracts remain external. Allocation-failure recursion, mutable r13 inside lower allocation services and full ABI are not established.

field_runtime_adapter.scope: Original PPC full-context and seeded ordinary-memory comparisons through actual strong wrappers: direct and mapping-table calls, disabled and enabled gates, with original fallback counts checked.
field_runtime_adapter.implementation: The existing named field operations share ApplyWith templates between bounded GuestMemory and the exact-width volatile PPC_LOAD/PPC_STORE backend. No atomic operations or barriers are added.

build.runtime: Incremental full runtime compile/link passed after the field wrapper integration, reusing the supplied PPC archive.
build.semantic_library: The subsequent read-only, memory-write and CRT lifecycle modules compiled and linked into the semantics library; they have no runtime wrappers yet.
build.reused_evidence: Old semantic and wrapper suites and baseline scene runs were not repeated. No source/image hashes or full PPC regeneration were performed.

scene_smoke.baseline: runtime_checkpoint.json and runtime_accessor_checkpoint.json; earlier baseline observations reused
scene_smoke.configuration: D3D12, 1280x720, 30 FPS cap; AA/upscaling/HDR off; copied seed save/profile and isolated writable state
scene_smoke.observed: Reached Map 20, Uhra - Residential Area; a Y-button pulse opened the main menu. Captures showed the player, environment, HUD and menu with no observed crash or visible structural regression.

next_cached_candidates.note: This is the remainder of one cached short-memory candidate pool, not the whole-program remainder.

acceptance_limits: All four runtime gates remain disabled by default. Per-entry scene execution was not traced.
